summary: Frontend-only verification of the /careers JoinOurTeam bg fix, global theme audit on all 6 /solutions/* product pages, and two regression checks (About Us single-line typing, Solutions method-chapters). ALL 6 requested items PASS. Zero residual cream/beige/tan hex codes remain in active pages. JoinOurTeam section outer bg = rgb(241,242,250) (#f1f2fa) and inner container = rgb(255,255,255) with 1px border rgb(212,216,232) (#d4d8e8) - confirmed via DOM inspection and screenshot. 12 job listings (job-row-1..job-row-12) render on click of 'See open roles'. Direct-channel cards (Contact Number / Email / LinkedIn / X (Twitter)) render on white panels. About Us typing heading has whiteSpace:nowrap and renders in 1 line (height 57px @ 44px font). Solutions method chapters contain METHOD/TRAINING/SPECIALIZATION/OPTIMIZATION markers and 01/02/03 numbers.
critical_code_review_comments: Legacy cream hex codes (#efede5, #e6e2d4, #d3cdb9, #e8edd8, #e8e6de, #f9f7f0) still exist in *_backup.jsx / Careers_backup.jsx / _AboutUs_backup.jsx / _Home_backup_v2.jsx files. These backup files are not routed and do not affect rendering, but they should ideally be removed from git to avoid future confusion during greps.

The only rgb match in the 'cream-range' heuristic on /solutions/deployment was Tailwind neutral #E5E7EB (rgb 229,231,235) used for progress-bar tracks (w-full h-1 bg-[#E5E7EB]) - this is a neutral gray, not a cream, so classifying it as cream would be a false positive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Global theme sweep verified complete. Active pages contain zero legacy cream hex codes. Only backup files (files with _backup or _ prefix in /app/frontend/src/pages/) still contain them, but they are not routed. Key data-testids on /careers: see-open-roles-btn, job-listings-section, job-row-1..job-row-12. On /about-us the typing span uses whiteSpace:nowrap - do not add flex-wrap or grid there.
